title: Brushing as well as you can, once: what a dentist found on 91 students [limit_one_event, limit_n91, limit_students]
teaser: A trial gave 111 students one of two instructions: brush as thoroughly as you can, or brush as usual. [randomized_111, instruction_bp, instruction_au] The best-effort group brushed for nearly a minute longer. [nearly_one_minute] Plaque left along the gumline showed no clear difference between the groups. [plaque_after_ns] Both groups thought their teeth were about twice as clean as they were. [overestimate_twofold]
hook: Students told to brush as well as they could believed 70% of their gumline was clean. [instruction_bp, bp_thought_70] The dentists found less than 40% of it free of plaque. [under_40_clean]
populationPanel: Who was studied: university students in Giessen aged 18 to 35. [limit_students, inclusion_age] All mainly used a manual toothbrush. [inclusion_manual_brush] A drawn lot gave each of 111 students one of two instructions before brushing once. [randomization_lots, randomized_111, limit_one_event] People with braces, dentures, a recent professional cleaning or dental training could not take part. [exclusion_criteria]

paragraphs: Plaque is a sticky film on the teeth. [-] The film left along the gumline is one important cause of gum disease. [marginal_plaque_cause] More than half of adults have that disease. [prevalence]
So a dentist’s idea of clean is strict: every bit of film gone, gumline included. [spoc_dentist_standard] The authors think most people brush to remove the plaque others can see. [social_motive]

This trial asked what happens when you tell people to try harder. [instruction_bp] Students told to brush as thoroughly as they could brushed nearly a minute longer. [instruction_bp, nearly_one_minute] Most of the extra time went to the outer surfaces. [extra_time_outer]

How they brushed showed no clear difference. [shares_ns] About two-thirds in both groups skipped at least one section of the mouth. [missed_a_sextant] About one in ten never brushed their inner surfaces at all. [inner_never_brushed] Side-to-side scrubbing, which is generally discouraged, showed no clear difference between the groups. [horizontal_not_reduced, shares_ns]

Afterwards, plaque along the gumline showed no clear difference between the groups. [plaque_after_ns] Less than 40% of the gumline came out free of plaque. [under_40_clean] In the best-effort group, plaque stayed on 80% of the gumline sections between the teeth. [proximal_80]

The gap is one people cannot see. [not_aware] The best-effort group believed 70% of their gumline was clean. [bp_thought_70] Both groups rated their teeth about twice as clean as the dentists found. [overestimate_twofold] The authors read this as trying harder meaning more time, not reaching more of the teeth. [quantity_not_quality]

paragraphs: Each student came twice, two weeks apart, and cleaned nothing for at least four hours before each visit. [visits_two_weeks, no_hygiene_4h] A drawn lot set the instruction they got before brushing. [randomization_lots] It was either brush as thoroughly as you can so your teeth are completely clean, or brush as usual. [instruction_bp, instruction_au] They brushed at both visits; plaque after brushing was scored at the second. [plaque_second_visit]

Everyone got the same manual toothbrush and toothpaste, with floss and small between-teeth brushes free to use on a table. [standard_brush, devices_on_table, devices_available] A tablet camera served as the mirror and filmed the brushing. [camera_mirror] A red film on its screen hid the plaque dye. [stain_hidden] Dentists who did not know the instruction scored plaque before and right after brushing. [blinding, plaque_twice]

audit.effect: Gumline plaque after brushing, best effort against as usual: no clear difference (t89 = 1.045; p = 0.149; d = 0.22). [plaque_after_ns]
audit.weakEnd: The paper reports no confidence interval for this result, only the test above. [plaque_after_ns] The authors add that every unclear difference was far below what the planned sample could detect. [nonsig_far_below]
limitations: Only university students took part, so the result may not hold for others. [limit_students]
It was one brushing session, so nobody knows what trying harder for weeks would do. [limit_one_event, limit_longer_period]
The as-usual group may have tried harder than at home to meet social expectations. [limit_au_norms, limit_au_longer]
The study analysed only 91, short of the 102 it planned for. [limit_n91, power_calculation]
The authors registered the trial only after collecting the data. [registration_retrospective]
audit.missed: Two-thirds of the best-effort group cleaned between their teeth, against one-quarter of the as-usual group. [interdental_share] That showed no clear sign of a cleaner gumline between the teeth. [interdental_no_benefit] Only 4 people in each group flossed correctly. [floss_correct]
more: The best-effort group rated their teeth cleaner (t88 = 2.548; p = 0.006; d = 0.54). [felt_cleaner]
The best-effort group brushed longer (t89 = -2.700; p = 0.008; d = -0.57), mainly on the outer surfaces (p = 0.003). [brushed_longer, time_total, time_outer]
On the outer surfaces the plaque differences were medium-sized, d = 0.37 and d = 0.46, but not clear. [outer_effect_sizes, limit_coronal]
One hundred and six finished; 15 of them were then left out for extreme values. [finished_106, excluded_15]
The as-usual group had more decayed, missing or filled teeth. [dmft_imbalance] Leaving out the five with the most kept the results pointing the same way. [dmft_sensitivity]
Paid for from an author’s institutional budget; no conflicts of interest declared. [funding, no_conflicts]

glossary.plain: A dye painted on the teeth that colours plaque, so the dentists could see and score it.
The sides of the teeth that face the tongue.

takeaways: Told to brush their best, students brushed nearly a minute longer, mostly on the outer surfaces. [nearly_one_minute, extra_time_outer]
Plaque along the gumline afterwards showed no clear difference from brushing as usual. [plaque_after_ns]
The authors suggest teaching which surfaces to reach and showing people what they miss; the trial did not test that. [emphasize_quality]

steps.detail: About one in ten people in this trial never brushed the sides that face the tongue. The trial did not test this step, so it carries no weight. A tick records that you brushed them.

steps.label: Reach every section of your mouth
